Name: Better Water 2 (Content Patcher)
Author: Neopffe
Description:
[b][size=5]Updated for 1.6[/size][/b]

[b][color=#f4f4f4][size=5]Features:[/size][/color][/b][list]
[*]Configurable in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*]Color options: Teal, Dark, Blue, Bright or Disabled
[*]Transparency options: Opaque, Semi-opaque, Translucent, Mixed or Disabled
(Mixed option combines Semi-opaque on beach and translucent everywhere else)[*]Waterfalls that matches the color option
[*]And more, see the preview images
[/list]

[*]Any map recolors
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
